scope: Read-only audit of the GTK2 theme packages and engine install path for author-specific absolute paths or temporary paths that would break publication.

findings.author_specific_absolute_paths: No matches for /home/lsi, /tmp, /run/user/1000, the developer workspace, XChat cache paths, or records paths in the three GTK2 packages, engine build/install tools, package manifest source, and distribution instructions.
findings.runtime_staging: The engine updater derives the current user home with Path.home() and stages under ~/tempia/domainos-theme-work/I167/gtk2-engine-stage. It creates the directory with mode 0700 and uses a UUID filename, then unlinks the staged .so in finally. No author username is embedded.
findings.package_contents: The public suite manifest includes the portable GTK2 engine source, builder, and user-profile installer; package names are relative paths validated against absolute paths and .. traversal.
findings.variant_consistency: The base, KDE, and Reload GTK2 gtkrc recipes have the same current source hash.

result: No author-specific or machine-specific absolute path was found in the audited publishable GTK2 files. The only temp path is intentionally user-relative and follows this project’s ~/tempia rule; it is created for the invoking user and removed after the engine build stage.
limits: This was a source-path audit, not a clean-room installation on another computer.
No package was built or installed, and no source/theme file was changed.
The separate V03 visual review remains unreviewed.
next: Keep T04 running and I167 waiting_user for visual review; no packaging-path correction was indicated by this audit.

coverage_estimate.basis: Additional distribution-source evidence only; not a fidelity or human-acceptance score.
